research_question: When does an auditable, branch-preserving research process improve scientific decisions and human learning beyond polished output quality, and when does it merely add process overhead?
decision_owner: Researchers and research-system designers deciding how much autonomy, auditability, and human source review to require.
worlds: W1: Persistent hypotheses, evidence, failed branches, and decision reversals expose errors and improve later research decisions.
W2: Output/task quality is sufficient; extra process artifacts add documentation without changing decisions.
W3: Autonomous optimization improves task-native metrics while weakening human understanding or scientific validity outside the fixed evaluator.
discriminator: Compare revision-pinned research tasks with equivalent sources and budgets under output-only versus branch/evidence-preserving protocols; independent reviewers must make blinded source-grounded decisions and humans must demonstrate source-linked understanding rather than preference ratings alone.
falsifier: The auditable protocol does not change error detection, route decisions, source-grounded understanding, or held-out validity after controlling for time and artifact volume.
scope: Method-free R0 problem framing; any benchmark, replay system, or visualization is an instrument.
does_not_establish: Review-only source reduction; no gap, novelty, prevalence, proposal, or lifecycle transition is established.

source_spans.title: AutoResearchBench: Benchmarking AI Agents on Complex Scientific Literature Discovery
source_spans.observation: Shows literature agents fail on constraint verification, execution, aggregation, and termination despite producing search trajectories.
source_spans.leaves_unresolved: Human learning or general scientific validity.
source_spans.does_not_establish: End-to-end scientific quality, human learning, or superiority of one research-process protocol.

source_spans.title: Toward Generalist Autonomous Research via Hypothesis-Tree Refinement
source_spans.observation: Shows persistent-tree optimization gains under fixed task-native evaluators without step-level human supervision.
source_spans.leaves_unresolved: Human learning and open-ended scientific quality.
source_spans.does_not_establish: That this process improves human understanding, scientific validity, or open-ended topic choice.

source_spans.title: Toward Auditable AI Scientists: A Hypothesis Evolution Protocol for LLM Agents
source_spans.observation: Externalizes hypotheses, evidence, and belief changes in an append-only protocol.
source_spans.resolves: An auditability mechanism and lifecycle discipline.
source_spans.leaves_unresolved: Calibrated beliefs, human learning, or broad transfer.
source_spans.does_not_establish: Human learning benefits, calibrated belief truth, or transfer beyond the tested materials-science tasks.

derived_questions.question: Which preserved process object most often reverses an independent review decision: failed branch, source locator, evidence update, or route history?
derived_questions.smallest_discriminator: One blinded paired review over output-only and append-only process records with identical source access.

derived_questions.question: Can a human reconstruct and challenge a research claim from source-linked notes without reading an AI-generated summary as authority?
derived_questions.smallest_discriminator: One claim with original PDF spans, native human notes, and a subsequent disagreement-driven route update.

controller_boundary: Independent review is required before any route or promotion decision.
